{{Top|leg}}
The '''[[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]] Underwriters' Union''' was a collection of insurance agencies that provided backing to the various [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] arenas and leagues that were operating during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The union insured racers and support crews, as well as the arena operators for all manner of possible issues.<ref name="SWBH" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] which plagued the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the Union issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Jord Stokk]]; a bounty which was filled by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="SWBH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
